dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: They're watching us. Act normal! Don't look, but there are two men in black over there.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Really? I don't see anyone. Maybe you've been reading too many detective novels.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Idiot! I'm not joking. It's just like how you nghĩ about kết hôn. Do you believe in đợi until kết hôn?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Wait for what? Oh, that... I nghĩ each người has the right to decide for themselves. But I respect những người who want to đợi until kết hôn.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I've always believed that đợi until kết hôn is đúng đắn. In Russia, my family is very traditional. But many người think this view is outdated.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: It's không outdated, just cultural differences. I nghĩ if two người truly love each other, they'll respect each other's boundaries. What do you think about những người who don't đợi?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Người have the right to choose, but I find đợi until kết hôn creates something special. Like a chess game, sometimes you have to be patient and đợi for the perfect move. Those men are still looking at us!
